_comment: The eight lines the first-run picker offers — four styles × two colours.
`moves` is the full line in SAN. `cuts` says how many of THE USER'S OWN
moves each level keeps: the picker truncates to that many, which always
lands on the user's own move (White = odd ply, Black = even ply) so a saved
line ends on a move they have to remember, matching the app's convention.
Cuts are 3 / 5 / 7 wherever the line is long enough, and capped at the
line's own length where it isn't — Polish stops at 6, Owen at 4.
Every line and every cut is checked by openings.selftest.ts: each must be
legal, must end on the user's move, and must resolve an opening name.

lines.name: Italian Game
lines.blurb: Natural, safe, and it never goes out of fashion.

lines.name: Scotch Game
lines.blurb: Rips the centre open early and keeps the initiative.

lines.name: Polish Opening
lines.blurb: Nobody expects 1.b4. That's rather the point.

lines.name: Caro-Kann
lines.blurb: Tough to crack. Very hard to lose quickly.

lines.name: Sicilian, Najdorf
lines.blurb: Black fights for the win from move one.

lines.name: French, Classical
lines.blurb: Solid, strategic, and full of ideas.

lines.name: Owen's Defence
lines.blurb: Straight out to the long diagonal. Cheeky, and sound.
